The Dynamic Heming Elite 2-Person Corner Infrared Sauna is the perfect addition to any home wellness space. Designed for maximum relaxation and efficiency, this sauna features Ultra Low EMF infrared heating panels, a compact corner-friendly design, and luxury wellness features.

Crafted from sustainably sourced Canadian Hemlock, the Heming Elite sauna ensures efficient heat retention and long-lasting durability. Its bronze-tinted tempered glass door and side windows provide a sleek, modern look while maintaining privacy. The sauna's PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF heating technology ensures a safe and deep-penetrating heat experience, making it an ideal choice for health-conscious individuals.

Ultra Low EMF Infrared Sauna for Maximum Wellness

The Dynamic Heming Elite 2-Person Corner Sauna is designed to deliver an effective and safe infrared heat therapy session. It features seven strategically placed PureTech™ FAR Infrared Carbon Heating Panels, which provide consistent and even heat distribution. With EMF levels below 3MG at a 6-8 inch seating distance, this sauna offers a low-EMF environment for safer infrared exposure.

The corner-friendly design makes it ideal for home gyms, wellness rooms, walk-in closets, and master bathrooms. Its space-saving layout ensures that you get the full benefits of an infrared sauna without compromising on space.

Why Choose the Dynamic Heming Elite Infrared Sauna?

  • Ultra Low EMF Technology – Features 7 PureTech™ FAR Infrared Carbon Heating Panels, emitting under 3MG of EMF at a safe distance.
  • Space-Saving Corner Design – Fits seamlessly into any corner, making it ideal for homes, apartments, or wellness rooms.
  • Premium Craftsmanship – Constructed with sustainably sourced Canadian Hemlock for durability, heat retention, and a modern aesthetic.
  • Luxury Wellness Features – Chromotherapy lighting, red light therapy, and Bluetooth connectivity provide an enhanced sauna experience.
  • Smart Controls & Entertainment – Interior & exterior LED control panels, built-in Bluetooth speakers, MP3 auxiliary input, and an FM station.

This sauna is designed to be both functional and stylish, making it a perfect wellness investment for your home.

Key Features of the Dynamic Heming Elite Sauna

1. PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF Infrared Heating

The Heming Elite sauna is equipped with 7 FAR infrared heating panels, strategically positioned for maximum heat coverage. These panels include:

  • Two panels on each of the two rear walls
  • Two panels under the bench
  • One panel on the floorboard

2. Chromotherapy & Red Light Therapy for Enhanced Wellness

This sauna features an advanced chromotherapy lighting system that uses various colors to promote relaxation and well-being.

3. Premium Build with Canadian Hemlock

Made from 100% natural reforested Canadian Hemlock, this sauna is eco-friendly, durable, and visually appealing. The bronze-tinted tempered glass door and side windows provide privacy while maintaining a sleek, modern design.

4. Smart Control Panel & Bluetooth Audio System

This sauna includes a dual interior/exterior LED control panel for easy temperature and lighting adjustments. The built-in Bluetooth speakers and MP3 auxiliary input let you enjoy your favorite music or podcasts while relaxing.

Specifications & Electrical Requirements

  • Capacity: 2-Person
  • Exterior Dimensions: 76” H x 49” W x 50” D
  • Heating System: 7 PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon Heating Panels
  • Glass Type: Bronze-Tinted Tempered Glass Door & Side Windows
  • Control System: Interior & Exterior LED Touchscreen Control Panels
  • Lighting System: Chromotherapy & Red Light Therapy
  • Audio System: Bluetooth, FM Station & MP3 Auxiliary with Built-in Speakers
  • Temperature Range: 118°F - 132°F (Maximum 140°F)
  • Electrical Requirements: 120V, 15A Non-GFCI Plug & Play (Dedicated Outlet Recommended)

Invest in Your Health with the Dynamic Heming Elite Infrared Sauna

The Dynamic Heming Elite 2-Person Corner Infrared Sauna is a perfect blend of innovation, comfort, and luxury. Its space-saving corner design, ultra-low EMF heating, and premium wellness features make it a top choice for home relaxation.

Upgrade your home with the Heming Elite Infrared Sauna today!
